channel_model.description: SV = D2-pipeline prior SV8e, clustered Saleh-Valenzuela (El Ayach TWC 2014; code/sv.py): 8 clusters x 10 rays per block, cluster-mean AoA ~ U[-60,60] deg, AoD ~ U[-180,180) deg (UE yaw), Laplacian ray offsets (std 7.5 deg, both sides), ray gains CN(0,1/80) iid normalised per block to sum|alpha|^2 = 1, no LOS, H = sqrt(Nr Nt) sum_cr alpha_cr a_r a_t^H (unit-norm half-wavelength ULAs)
